load_xlmr_pretrained: load a pretrained XLMR model using XLMRModel.from_pretrained with model name or path
list_xlmr_hub_models: list available XLMR hub models like xlmr.base and xlmr.large via hub_models
register_xlmr_model: register the XLMR model architecture with fairseq using the xlmr model name
review_XLMRModel_from_pretrained: review the XLMRModel.from_pretrained method that loads models and returns a RobertaHubInterface
review_XLMRModel_hub_models: review the XLMRModel.hub_models class method that returns available model download URLs
